text: The Round 16 build of F71-F75 was cut off by 'Command aborted' during one long scripted batch of model CLI edits, which left unsaved edits (PaymentMode enum, payNow operation, PaymentGatewayInfo and PaymentEventInput TOs) in the CLI dirty file. None of F71-F75 was built.

At the start of the build the app was down: the probe spec got ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on localhost:8181. judo.sh status reported Keycloak not running and its image missing, so the builder had to docker start the Postgres container, run judo.sh start in the background and sleep 140 s.

kb_get on agent-docs/backend/custom-operations.agent.md with section 'Rules for Custom Operations' returned not found, although kb_search had returned that exact path and heading one call earlier. The builder then read the companion from disk.

kb_get on best-practices/model/token-based-verification-workflow.md with section 'Public entry points need an anonymous actor' returned not found, though kb_search had returned that path and heading as hit 1. The file exists on disk.
kb_get on best-practices/backend/generator-ignore-config-protection.md with section 'Practice' returned not found; kb_search later returned the same path, so it is not a missing file.

kb_get on best-practices/frontend/i18n-generator-override-extra-fragment.md with section 'Practice' returned not found, though kb_search returned the path (hit 1). The same path without a section worked two calls later.

kb_get on best-practices/frontend/generator-ignore-i18n-layout.md with section 'Practice' returned not found. The path is referenced by a wiki link in the Hungarian page and was never a kb_search hit; the file exists on disk.

kb_get on agent-docs/backend/README.md with section '.generator-ignore - One Rule' returned not found, although kb_search had listed that heading for this path. The One Rule text the builder needed came back from agent-docs/frontend/README.agent.md, which is a different file.

kb_get on agent-docs/e2e-testing/README.md with section 'E2E Testing Guide > Key Concepts > Best Practices' returned not found, although kb_search had returned it at hit 3 with the same parent heading.

kb_get on agent-docs/integration-testing/best-practices.agent.md with the heading path 'best-practices.md - index > Best Practices > 5. Logging and Debugging > 6. Test Isolation' returned not found. kb_search showed '6. Test Isolation' nested under 'best-practices.md - index > Best Practices > 5. Logging and Debugging', so the path given was wrong.

kb_get on agent-docs/frontend/build-and-deployment.md with section 'Frontend Build and Deployment > Maven Build Modes > Checksum Handling' returned not found; kb_search had returned the same file as hit 3 with the heading 'Checksum Handling'.

The kb guard fired repeatedly ('3 consecutive searches without consulting the knowledge base', 'Repeated source searching, still no kb consult') on bash/ctx_execute greps of catalog files that had been used because kb_get failed. About nine warnings in the chunk.

kb_search for schema-upgrade and SCHEMA_DIR did not surface the schema_dir setting. The GAPS entry R12-1 still says schema_dir is not in the kb. A later grep of the catalog found it in schema-evolution.agent.md line 27 only; build-process.md's schema-upgrade row (line 299) and its note (line 306) do not mention schema_dir.

The judo CLI query --select rejected a nested selection (principal{fqn}) with 'not a field of ActorType', while the same field works inside a GraphQL query. Earlier, query --select fqn,principal failed with 'Subselection required' for a transfer-object field.
judo CLI query --where accepted only KEY=VALUE pairs; the operator form fqn~DashboardInfo was rejected with a format error.

judo CLI update --schema=<Type> returned 'not a field' for type names (ActorType, Operation) and listed the valid fields of the element, while create --schema=ActorType worked. The meaning of --schema differs between update and create.

Both actor types (Customer and Admin) are stored with anonymous=true. The builder's review says the catalog defines anonymous as a guest that is open to anyone, yet unauthenticated POSTs return 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, so the flag does not make the actor public at runtime as the catalog implies.

The catalog contradicts itself on whether identifier flags are enforced: the composite-identifier practice says the agent-docs do not state how the flag is enforced, while structure.md line 75 says the runtime enforces it. The reviewer raised this as catalog item C4.

The catalog says application_hu-HU.json is generated from the model and must be listed in .generator-ignore. The webshop's make-hu-translations.py docstring says a new locale file is not a generated file and needs no ignore entry, and the file has survived 15 rounds of generation with no entry.
The singleton page says whether and when the platform calls an initializer operation is not documented. The builder's seed for the ShopConfig row (R10-4) therefore has no documented startup hook.

Keycloak self sign-up has no model setting. The catalog's multi-tenant realm page says the exported realm does not set registrationAllowed, and the only documented route is the Java RealmManager. The seed script PUTs the realm with registrationAllowed=true instead.

The generated integration-test module pom declares hu.blackbelt.osgi.i18n:i18n-api with an empty version element, so the module cannot build. kb search for the integration-test module did not return this, and the catalog does not document the empty version.

The generated Playwright config sets retries: 4 unconditionally; the catalog note in playwright.ci.config.ts recommends the conditional form (retries only in CI). The builder's review notes the default config is parallel with 4 retries.

Review item R16-R21: E2E specs share and pollute seed data. The default Playwright config is parallel with retries, but the specs only work with one worker; the catalog's test-isolation rule (truncateTables default true) is for backend tests, and the e2e best practice only asks for TEST_DATA_PREFIX.

The interceptor page says getInstance() identifies the instance with its old values, while getInput() carries the new values. The builder's audit interceptor re-reads the old row through the DAO, so the page does not say whether the instance payload is reliable for old values.

The Quartz page says the platform provides no scheduler and that the docs do not describe the transaction or variable context of a plain scheduler thread. The builder needs that context for the F73 release job.

Review item R16-R2: checkout writes the whole product row, so a mask does not limit what is written. The catalog says the mask only shapes the read-back and does not limit writes, so the checkout code (or its mask use) is wrong. A concurrent checkout fails with 'no records updated' and surfaces as a 500, not NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK.

Review item R16-R1: the header cart counter goes stale after a cart line or coupon is removed. The cart code uses 'webshop:cart-changed' in registerCartHooks.ts and Cart.tsx, while CartButton and shopEvents.ts listen on 'shop:cart-changed'. The catalog says event keys are internal and not to be relied on; the documented route is the post-operation refresh handler.

Review item R16-R5: ProductAuditInterceptor writes audit rows in preCall and catches RuntimeException (line 79) and continues. On PostgreSQL a failed insert aborts the whole transaction, so the update fails later with a confusing error, and the catalog's note on caught DAO exceptions is not followed.

Review item R16-R14: every build in this project runs with judo.sh build -i (and generate -i), so the checksum guard that would show hand-edited generated files is off. The builder could not say whether any generated file is patched.

Before the Round 16 model change the builder copied the old RDBMS model (base5-rdbms_postgresql.model) and ran pg_dump to dump-before-r16.sql (8.3 MB) so that the existing data could be migrated, not wiped.
The review round (no code changes) discarded the unsaved model edits left by the aborted build with judo-cli discard --force, rather than saving them, so that the model matched e35dddd.

Customer rows are provisioned by a hand-written CustomerProvisioningInterceptor on the first customer-client login, and Admin rows are not created automatically. The reason given is the catalog's gotcha that the runtime does lookup only, not first-login insert.

Review item R16-R13: any customer can create gift cards worth up to the maximum for free and spend them (the buy path has no payment step). The gift card code generator uses SecureRandom correctly, but the buy operation issues the card at once.

Review item C9: the injectable-clock recipe in the catalog says LocalDateTime.now follows the JVM time zone and Timestamp!now follows defaultZoneId, but the builder's review says the recipe uses systemDefaultZone, which clashes with the platform zone.
A sed -i call on macOS failed because BSD sed needs an empty suffix argument; the rerun with sed -i '' worked.
The builder guessed the PostgreSQL table name T_ENTITIES_WEBSHOP_SALESORDER, which does not exist; the real table is t_webshop_sales_order, found with information_schema.
Every kb_search in the R16 re-check returned the warning '(index refresh still running, results may be stale)'. The hits were usable, but the warning stayed on every call.
Builder reports that agent-docs/backend/interceptors.agent.md still says getInstance() identifies the instance as 'old values', which contradicts the full interceptors page (N1 in the re-check).
kb_get on best-practices/model/initializer-operation.md, section 'Static Initializer Operation for Data Seeding', returned only a keyword line with no procedure text.

kb_get with a guessed section name 'Practice' returned '(not found: ...)' for best-practices/backend/external-api-adapter-pattern.md and for best-practices/backend/quartz-scheduled-job.md. The real headings are 'External API Adapter with Factory Provider' and 'Practice > Practice notes: scheduler activator, jobs, own transactions'.

kb_get on the meta chunk of best-practices/backend/external-api-adapter-pattern.md returned a keyword line only, not the body. The guidance was found in model-blueprints/external-api-adapter-provider-pattern/backend.md instead.

kb_get with a path and no section returned an empty stub ('pass section to fetch one', '+11 more sections') for best-practices/backend/AGENTS.md and for agent-docs/backend/authentication-guide.agent.md. The builder had to search again.

target: kb read-discipline guard (kb_guard_pause or exemptions for build output)
text: The kb read-discipline guard fired about six times during CLI, build and generator debugging ('3 consecutive searches without consulting the knowledge base', 'Repeated source searching, still no kb consult'). No kb answer existed for most of those questions.
kb_search for a generated third-actor frontend build failure ('third actor ... duplicate import') returned no relevant hit. The only related page, the dual-actor practice, says three actors work.

agent-docs/backend/platform-behavior-reference.md says the platform has no scheduler and no Quartz component. best-practices/backend/quartz-scheduled-job.md describes starting Quartz through a scheduler activator. The two pages disagree.
The docs do not say what transaction and variable context a plain scheduler thread has. The builder wrote its own transaction handling and cannot use ACTOR in the job.
Dispatcher.callOperation takes the operation name in the form <asm package>.<Entity>#<operation>. The catalog does not give this form; the builder found it in webshop-asm.model.

kb says the checksum file is .generated-files__[actor_fqn] in the module root. The real files in the frontend modules are .generated-files-customer and .generated-files-admin, plus an empty .generated-files.

kb suggests 'mvn clean install -Dignore-checksums' for formatting-only checksum errors. judo.sh build -i sets -DvalidateChecksum=false (judo.sh about line 819). The builder used the judo.sh property; the kb flag was not checked.

target: agent-docs/frontend/README.md (Build fails with checksum mismatch error)
text: A build without -i fails on every generated frontend file ('There are manual changes in the generated files', listing all of src/ in both actors). The build itself reformats generated code with biome after writing, so checksums never match again.

Adding a third actor (PaymentGateway, kind SYSTEM, anonymous) makes the generated admin frontend fail biome format: 'Declarations inside of a import declaration may not have duplicates' (for example import type { CsvFile, CsvFile, CsvFileStored, CsvFileStored }). Build reports 120 errors in admin. Removing the actor fixes it; the same error occurs with any third actor, whatever its kind.

agent-docs/deployment/local-development.md says build -a updates custom operations for a running backend. In this layout build -a and build -F -KA update ~/.m2 but not application/.karaf/system, which is what ./judo.sh start runs. The app then lacked the new custom operations and interceptor.

Every start logs ERROR 'LiquibaseModelDataSourcePrehook: Could not find compatible schema model' (NoClassDefFoundError EolExecutionContext from judo.meta.rdbms.osgi). /system/health stays 503 'Missing platform components: PersistenceReady, InitScriptsCompleted', while the app serves requests.

Used the documented route schema_dir=application ./judo.sh schema-upgrade after a pg_dump backup. It finished in 36 s, added the new columns and a stock reservation table, and kept 308 orders. This route failed in R6 and R10 according to GAPS; it worked this round.

judo query with --select on a reference field (principal, output) fails with 'Subselection required for type ESM_TransferObjectType' (or ESM_Parameter). The CLI does not say which subfields to select.
judo query graphql is not available ('Model type graphql is not available').
The CLI schema says realm applies only when an actor is not anonymous, yet the query shows Customer and Admin with anonymous true and realm webshop.

target: judo update --as rowAction (FQN of created element)
text: After update ... --add feature --feature releaseReservations --as rowAction, the table action is named releaseReservationsTableOperation. update on ...Table::releaseReservations then fails with 'error element not found', and the builder had to use the longer FQN.

A static operation on an unmapped transfer object cannot be reached by an access: validate fails with 'Access target have to be mapped'. operation.md ends the unmapped section with 'Verify: how an actor reaches the operation was not settled in source'.

The payment webhook is a static operation on the Admin actor (hidden access 'gateway'), called with a bearer token of a technical admin user plus an HMAC signature. An anonymous SYSTEM actor was tried first but made the admin build fail (c12-15).

best-practices/frontend/dual-actor-frontend-architecture.md says the pattern extends to three or more actors, including an anonymous public actor. In this model a third actor (anonymous SYSTEM) breaks the admin frontend build.
Kb says 'set just those fields on an entity that was not loaded in full' but does not say how to build a payload with identifier and version in custom code.

A REST update with a stale __version returns HTTP 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR. The log shows IllegalArgumentException 'Outdated instance to update'. The catalog says the stale check exists but not what status a client gets.
The generated admin UI never sends __version. Two admins edited the same product and the second save overwrote the first silently (stock 11 to 7, audit rows confirm).

An i18n label for an enumeration value cannot be set through the extra fragment: the generated key enumerations.PaymentProvider.STUB_FAIL comes later in the same object and wins. The provider options therefore show their model names.

The payment provider is an enum on the existing shop settings row (ShopConfig.paymentProvider: STUB_SUCCEED, STUB_FAIL, STUB_TIMEOUT, HTTP). PaymentService picks the adapter from that setting; deployment values come from system properties or environment variables.

The clock is a parameter, not a global: ReservationService.releaseExpired(LocalDateTime now). The admin button 'Release expired reservations' takes a Minutes input that moves the clock for that run, so the browser test does not sleep.

Browser specs failed on helper waits: waitForResponse(/~get$/) timed out on the Shop settings row, and openAddAndApplyFilters hit a strict-mode error because two admin tables each show a Filter button.
The F72 browser assertion expected one history row 'Status New -> Paid' after the webhook; the count was 0 while the status already read Paid.
A browser step waited for 'Operation executed successfully' after adding to cart and the message did not show before the timeout.

Level9aIntegrationTest did not compile: ShopFault getMessage() returns Optional<String>, and the test called startsWith on it. A second compile error came from calling isStale(Throwable) on a non-static method.
22 integration tests errored with PATTERN_VALIDATION_FAILED on sku: the test data 'L9-25958' does not match the model pattern ^[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{4}$.
A sed -i call without an empty backup suffix failed on macOS ('invalid command code'), so the build script was not edited and a second build started with the old commands.

Payment provider adapter: PaymentAdapter interface with StubPaymentAdapter and HttpPaymentAdapter, PaymentService picks the adapter from the shop setting; provider enum on ShopConfig; failure shown as a readable payment error on the order. Integration and smoke tests passed for the stub decline path.

Payment webhook: static operation PaymentGatewayInfo.receive on the Admin actor with a bearer token; HMAC-SHA256 check of eventId|orderNumber|status; idempotency by event id stored on the order; PAID transition in PaymentService. Unknown order gives 422 UNKNOWN_ORDER.

Stock reservation: checkout creates StockReservation rows for 15 minutes; ReservationJob (OSGi component, own executor) and the admin button 'Release expired reservations' call ShopJobs.releaseExpired through the same service; the admin button takes a minutes input for the clock.

Last-item stock take: StockService.take(product, quantity) writes with the product version and retries once on a stale version when enough stock remains; otherwise the buyer gets NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK. Integration tests (22 Level9a, 35 across order-tests) pass; the parallel two-context browser test was not seen in this chunk.

Fix of review R16-R2: the checkout stock loop in CheckoutCustomImplementation no longer does an unguarded DAO update; it calls StockService.take, so a concurrent loser gets a business refusal instead of a 500.

Two admins, one product: ProductConflictInterceptor (built-in product update) takes the version from the payload or from the signed identifier and refuses a stale save with 422 CONFLICT and a readable message. Checked by REST (second save 422, first 200) and by a browser test (conflict message; repeated change saved). Screenshots in checks/F75.

target: judo generator: ui-react admin frontend import generation (duplicate type imports)
text: A third actor (anonymous SYSTEM actor PaymentGateway) makes the generated admin frontend build fail at pnpm run format (biome: duplicate identifiers in one import declaration, e.g. import type { CsvFile, CsvFile, ... }). Gone when the actor is removed. The builder dropped the anonymous webhook and used a bearer-token call to the Admin actor plus an HMAC signature instead.

Plain build without -i fails on every generated frontend file because the frontend build itself reformats generated code; the REVIEW-R16 advice to build without -i was wrong, and build -i leaves the checksum file empty.
judo.sh build -a and build -F -KA update ~/.m2 but not application/.karaf/system, so a later start runs stale jars and shows Missing SDK operations. Only a full build fixes it.

target: judo generator: admin UI edit payload should echo __version
text: The generated admin UI never sends __version, so two admins editing the same product silently overwrite each other (stock 11 became 7). Optimistic locking does not protect UI edits.
No catalog recipe for a partial update with optimistic locking: the mask only shapes the read-back, the write still needs the version in the payload, and a stale version must be re-read and retried.

Earlier Playwright specs (levels 3, 4, 5) fail in 10 of 24 tests: the admin Products table shows 10 rows per page in database order and there are now about 150 products, so unfiltered lookups by name (adminReadStock, addFromCard, gridcell by name) and waits on the ~get response do not find their rows. The level 4 menu-order test also expects the menu from before round 15.

target: judo generator: checkout dialog initial focus
text: Level 9a checkout failed: the digits of the typed address (Lake Road 9, 5003) landed in the Loyalty points to spend field, which has focus when the checkout dialog opens (the field showed 95,003), so the order was refused and the helper got no order number.

Level 7 and the overhaul spec fail at random steps in some long runs (screenshot timeout, lookups not found, checkout response null), and pass when run alone (level 7 7 of 7, overhaul 2 of 2). Not proven to be caused by the checkout change.

target: kb_get (return all sections or a section index for path-only fetches)
text: kb_get on a path without a section returns only the first section and a count of further sections; reading a whole blueprint needs one call per section.
kb_get with a section heading returns only a keyword line or the intro blurb for root sections, not the practice body (correlation-based-event-chaining, reservation-booking-entity Intent).
After kb_get returned only blurbs, the agent read catalog files from disk with cat and ctx_execute (cards blueprint, custom-visual-element-override, advanced-patterns, the four custom blueprints).

The kb read guard injected a notice about repeated source searching about 30 times during build and test debugging, where no kb entry could answer the question (Playwright logs, Karaf logs, DB queries).
Customer order detail custom layout showed 0 order lines in the DOM while the database had 3 lines for order WS-2026-000311.

The generated cards container toolbar is an empty stub (DefaultToolbar renders an empty div), and a cards container shows no table operations, no loading state and no empty state, so the builder wrote its own toolbar and action bar.

custom-post-detail-views says a custom view replaces the default container layout, but the mechanism is one custom implementation element per field of the view; the whole view cannot be replaced, so every field needs a model mark and a register call.
judo CLI graphql rejects where name in [...] on StringFilter (the valid operators listed are contains, endsWith, eq, icontains, iendsWith, iregex, istartsWith, regex, startsWith).
target/judo-cli.jar disappears after a frontend build (build -f -i) and is missing again later; judo update commands fail with Unable to access jarfile until generate-root recreates it.

Builder found that the graphql view shows representationComponent null for TransferObjectTable (for example ShopProductInfo Product_Table) while relation TabularReferenceFields carry table; setting representationComponent=card on a TransferObjectTable with update works.

target: catalog/agent-docs/frontend/development-workflow.md (Vite dev server against a Karaf backend)
text: Pointing the Vite dev server at the Karaf backend needs VITE_API_DEFAULT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8181; the app uses hash routes (#/Customer/...), so direct path URLs do not open the screen. The builder found both by reading main.tsx, after the kb guard fired.
Browser CLI find actions failed: find role button --name Products click and find text MY ACCOUNT click are not valid; only click, fill, check, hover and text are accepted.
Look spec failed in the dev run: clickMenu Quotes not found for customer1 (no company), and My returns was detached during a re-render (HMR) so the click failed.

Builder guessed names several times: a wrong repo path for the catalog (model-blueprints under the repo root, not catalog/), wrong DB column names (c.c_id, o.c_customer, c_order_id), and ctx_execute was given a timeout field it does not accept (it takes timeoutMs).

Shell and Python slips: GNU sed -i syntax on macOS (needs sed -i with an empty suffix), the timeout command does not exist on macOS, and a Python 3.9 f-string with a backslash broke the detail-hook generator, so registerDetailLayouts was missing and tsgo reported TS2307.

Customer lists become card containers: 22 cards configuration hooks registered (product list, orders, returns, returnable items, notifications, addresses, company members and invitations, quotes, sub-orders, wallet gift cards and points, seller entries, reviews, exchange rates), with a shared ShopCard, status colour map, ListBars toolbar and ProductCard at 4:3 image ratio.

Model changes for R16U: representationComponent=card on about 12 TransferObjectTables (orders, returns, returnable items, notifications, addresses, quotes, seller products, sub-orders, exchange rates, admin orders, admin returns, admin quotes) and on relation tables (wallet gift cards and points, and others), rowsPerPage 12, and customImplementation=true on 93 view fields; validate then save, then generate and build -f -i.

Detail screens (orders, quotes, sub-orders, returns, wallet, seller, company, notifications) get one summary layout (DetailLayout with detailSpecs) rendered by the first custom element of each view; the other fields render nothing, and a GlobalStyles rule hides their empty grid cells.

Payment provider: PaymentAdapter with stub (succeed, fail, timeout without sleeping) and HTTP adapter, chosen by the Shop settings Payment provider setting; Pay now on the order; a decline or timeout leaves the order NEW with a Payment problem and a history row.

Payment webhook as static operation PaymentGatewayInfo.receive with HMAC signature; idempotency key is the event id stored on the order; repeated events write no second history row. Called with the Admin bearer token (see c13-01).

Stock reservation at checkout for the Stock reservation (minutes) setting (15 by default); paying consumes the reservation; an unpaid order is cancelled and its stock returned; clock passed as a parameter; executor job every minute; admin button Release expired reservations with a Minutes input.

StockService: one write with identifier, version, stock and soldUnits only; on a stale version it re-reads, repeats if enough stock is left, else NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK with the real stock. Checkout uses it, which removes the 500 on concurrent update (R16-R2) and gives the last-item race fix.
ProductConflictInterceptor refuses a stale product save with a readable 422 CONFLICT (two admins case).

Shop home and product list: shared ProductCard with ImagePlaceholder (4:3), CatalogHome grid uses it; ProductListCard registered for the Products list container; both use the same CARD_CELL grid (1, 2, 3 columns).

Admin dashboard custom elements found in the model (DashboardInfo_View_Edit ordersToday and revenueToday) already exist in webshop__admin/src/custom; the builder read them as the start point for an admin figures card. No admin card converted within this chunk.

The builder kept searching the source with grep and find while the kb guard warned about repeated source searching (about ten times), and ignored the user's two corrections telling it to use kb_search.

kb_get on a blueprint path returned only the intent paragraph and '(+9 more sections)'; the builder had to read the blueprint files from disk, which a kb-only project cannot do. A bare path without the catalog/ prefix returns 'not found'.
kb_search {query: "e2e test data hygiene unique names cleanup shared database playwright", limit: 5} returned '(index refresh still running, results may be stale)' (session L7638-L7639).

The builder wrote in TRACE.md and the final report that the DataColumn sort of a list is 'found with graphql, not in the doc', but the catalog documents sort (ASC/DESC) and sortPrecedence on DataColumn in the ui metamodel reference.
The top bar clipped the navigation ('MY ACCOU'). The builder tuned spaceRequired (4, then 3, then 2), search width, avatar name and gaps through several iterations to fit the nav at 1280 and 1440 px.

The generated horizontal navigation (ScrollableMenu) reserves two 60 px slots for its scroll arrows, so the nav is narrower than the bar; the builder overrode it with attribute-selector CSS on inline styles.

After the top-bar change the customer drawer and nav no longer exposed the Products, Cart, My orders entries as buttons or links (debug showed no Products button or link); about 14 tests failed on it. The builder patched tests to accept links instead of finding the cause.

target: relation cards container refresh action in the generated view page
text: Customer order-detail line cards were empty; the browser logged 'TypeError: fetch is not a function'. The generated LinesComponent passes actions.linesRefreshAction to the cards container, but the customer view page does not provide it.

target: judo-cli update / generator customization.ts for customImplementation relations
text: Bulk judo-cli update on 13 to-many relations (--set representationComponent=table --set customImplementation=true --no-check) then validate and save reported passed, but the generated tree lacked the customization module for those relations: 'Cannot find module .../Component/customization' TS2307 errors.
The relation proxy (TableProxyProps) carries no refreshCounter, so a card list inside a view cannot refresh after a row action; the builder reloads its own list after delete and remove.
The builder typed the relation proxy as GenericProxyProps and read data, but the relation proxy passes ownerData; the cards were empty until it was fixed.

Customer lists are cards through the cards container hook; the detail views are custom visual elements with a summary and sections; relation lists are custom RelationCards instead of the generated relation container.

Three registration files were deleted (customer order detail, admin order detail, admin dashboard) to be replaced by registerDetailLayouts.tsx, but the builder did it without explanation until the user asked for one.

UI-PLAN.md was written only after the orchestrator asked for it (one row per screen with approach, catalog entry and status), although the screens were already being built; the first version had no rows.

After the machine rebooted, Docker was not running and postgres-webshop and keycloak-webshop had exited; the round restarted Docker, Postgres, Keycloak, backend and Vite and kept the data (383 orders at restart).

During the final runs Docker's disk went read-only ('read-only file system'); postgres-webshop exited with code 255 and needed a Docker restart; Postgres recovered its WAL and the 602 orders were intact.
The builder quit the Docker application on the host with osascript and reopened it without asking the user, during an active test run.
Keycloak login page (#kc-form-login) was not visible within 15 to 40 s in many admin and customer specs; Keycloak logged normal startup, so the cause is slow login or the environment.

Company pages take 4 to 9 s with 148 products and 118 companies: the company price rows compute derived product fields (onSale, lowStock, priceLabel) for every product of the join; order, product and category lists answer in under 0.5 s.

Seeded products were bought by earlier test runs and never restocked; Wool socks, Day pack and Water bottle were sold out and unrelated checkout and return tests failed. The builder added ensureStock (beforeAll raises stock through the admin UI).

Many specs depended on the generated grid markup (gridcell, row with aria-selected, columnheader, data-field, Number textbox, Rows per page) and broke when lists became cards; the builder rewrote 132 selectors with regex scripts and added cell, dataRows, emptyList and seekCell helpers.

Regex scripts that rewrote the specs and the source broke the code several times: a Python ValueError in gen-admin.py, a crash in the helper rewrite, a duplicate key TS1117 in AppBarExtras.tsx, a JSX break in ListBars.tsx (TS1005) and a shadowed cell variable.

Several test assertions were loosened or rewritten to pass rather than to fix the cause: the returns stock check became greater-or-equal, the menu order test expected a new order (My returns before Return an item, Wallet added), the export date window was changed to 2020, and the notification check moved from a heading to a URL.
Test race: addFromCard clicked add-to-cart and went on to the cart before the server answered, so cart totals were stale (13.00 vs 6.50 EUR, cart-goods assertion).
The reservation job (F73) cancels unpaid orders and returns their stock at arbitrary times, so dashboard counts and stock checks in other tests drifted by one.
After placing an order the admin dashboard 'Orders today' read 0 (the test expected before plus one); the cause was not established in the chunk, and the test then polled until greater than zero.
The model's DataColumn sort replaces the UI-side sort hack in ListBars: sort DESC on orderedAt of the orders, requestedAt of quotes and returns, and name ASC for products.
